name: LOCAL_DELIVERY_OR_PICKUP_EXCEPTED_WHITE_LONG
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheet's two edge figures are the white edge and edge + black border (6 / 18 = edge 6 + border 12), as the AS 1743 drawings. Sheet R9-SA105 (2022): R9-SA105B 900 x 750 illustrated (A 600 x 500, C 1200 x 1000 in the table; the register lists the A size first, PNG R9-SA105A.png), R100, 12 / 36 (edge 12 + border 24). Four lines 100 D, chain 185/160/160/160/85 (baselines): tops 85, 245, 405, 565. Widths LOCAL 409 (245/409/246), DELIVERY 609 (145/609/146), OR 161 + 75 + PICKUP 458 (103/161/75/458/103), EXCEPTED 622 (139/622/139). For use with R6-10-2 only.
